name: Thumb Ulnar Collateral Ligament Injury
definition: Injury of the thumb MCP ulnar collateral ligament, acute (skier's thumb) or chronic (gamekeeper's thumb), with possible Stener lesion.

core: Valgus stress at MCP in appropriate setting

investigations.principle: Radiographs exclude avulsion fracture; ultrasound/MRI can identify complete tear/Stener lesion.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Thumb-spica protection for suitable partial tears
amber: Complete displaced tears or Stener lesions usually require repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Angushtha-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the thumb MCP ulnar collateral ligament, acute (skier's thumb) or chronic (gamekeeper's thumb), with possible Stener lesion.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
